body.statement: Let \(X_{n1},\ldots,X_{nk_n}\) be independent, mean-zero random vectors of a fixed finite dimension.  If the sum of their covariance matrices converges to \(\Sigma\) and the multivariate Lindeberg condition holds, then \(\sum_iX_{ni}\) converges in distribution to the centered Gaussian law with covariance \(\Sigma\).
